notes.title: Gravebound Public Playtest
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce a weekend long playtest, open to any and all!

Available from Friday, August 8th @ 1PM EST - to Sunday, August 10th @ 8 PM Est.
Join us on Discord to praise, complain, or just hang out - and don't forget to [url=https://discord.gg/3tZaCeA8?event=1394745423549431890]RSVP for the Playtest event[/url]!



You should know this is a very early stage playtest.
...And we mean very. Expect broken things, missing features, placeholder art, and moments of chaos. But underneath the ash and rubble, you’ll get a first glimpse of the core systems that power Gravebound:
[list]
[*] Extraction missions against rogue AI
[*] Time-limited Missions
[*] Resource collection
[*] Weapons and Armor upgrades
[*] And more!
[/list]

It’s raw. It’s unstable. And it’s yours to explore — with zero NDA ;)
Stream it. Break it. Talk about it. Help us shape the future of Gravebound.

Your feedback will be critical as we forge Gravebound into the survival experience it’s meant to become.


We’ll see you on the other side. If you make it back...
